# shipd_sdk_key (Resource)

Registers an environment-bound client or server SDK key. Destroy revokes it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "runtime_sdk_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
  default   = null
}

resource "shipd_sdk_key" "runtime" {
  id              = "42e909cc-c7a8-492e-98cc-0f2f91c25878"
  organization_id = "org-id"
  project_id      = "project-id"
  environment_id  = "environment-id"
  name            = "Runtime"
  key_type        = "server"
  scopes          = ["snapshot:read"]
  secret_wo       = var.runtime_sdk_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment to which the key is bound.
- `id` (String) A stable, lowercase UUIDv4 for this credential generation. Use a fresh UUID and secret for every replacement.
- `key_type` (String) Either client or server.
- `name` (String) The credential's display name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the credential.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the environment.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Explicit SDK key scopes. Only server keys support identity:read.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp in RFC3339 format. Omit for a non-expiring SDK key.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Externally generated shipd credential with an organization tag. Required on creation and replacement. Supply it from a secret store through an ephemeral variable. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.

### Read-Only

- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether shipd has revoked the credential.
